method: Point-in-time troubleshooting source pack built from Google Search Console query rows, GA4 landing-page and event signals, official provider documentation, and the official Modrinth public API. This file does not collect API keys, host Verity downloads, or claim that an API error is a malware verdict.

observedDemand.ga4Window: Last 7 days checked July 30, 2026 at 23:05 Asia/Shanghai

providerSources.useFor: Request, token, audio, image, daily, and organization-level limit checks.
Local generate/chat API, model name, and local service troubleshooting.
Current Verity JE project identity, active version IDs, downloads, followers, and update timestamp.

statusRoutes.firstAction: Match Groq versus OpenRouter, rotate exposed keys, paste one fresh provider key locally, and retest one short text prompt.
statusRoutes.avoid: Do not post the API key or reinstall the same jar for a credential error.

statusRoutes.likelyLayer: Account, organization, model, route, content, or permission restriction
statusRoutes.firstAction: Check model access, provider permissions, account restrictions, and any guardrail or moderation message.
statusRoutes.avoid: Do not treat 403 as the same problem as a missing key.

statusRoutes.likelyLayer: Model ID, endpoint, or route configuration
statusRoutes.firstAction: Open the current provider model list and select a model supported by the installed Verity build.
statusRoutes.avoid: Do not use model IDs copied from old videos without checking the provider.

statusRoutes.likelyLayer: Request, token, audio, image, or daily rate limit
statusRoutes.firstAction: Stop retries, inspect the provider limits page, wait for the reset window, then test one short text prompt.
statusRoutes.avoid: Do not create repeated keys in the same organization as a quota fix.

statusRoutes.likelyLayer: Provider availability, upstream route, or temporary capacity
statusRoutes.firstAction: Wait, check provider status or model availability, and retry one short text prompt later.
statusRoutes.avoid: Do not rotate a valid key for a service availability error.

statusRoutes.likelyLayer: Local service, host, port, firewall, or missing local model
statusRoutes.firstAction: Start Ollama, confirm it answers outside Minecraft, and match the exact local endpoint and model in the Verity profile.
statusRoutes.avoid: Do not search for a cloud key when the route is local Ollama.

statusRoutes.likelyLayer: Model output, profile configuration, local service, integration log, or voice layer
statusRoutes.firstAction: Test one short typed prompt, compare model names and endpoints, and read a sanitized launcher or mod log.
statusRoutes.avoid: Do not diagnose voice until text succeeds.

statusRoutes.statusOrSymptom: Text works but voice does not
statusRoutes.likelyLayer: Speech recognition, TTS, device, language, voice dependency, or audio limit
statusRoutes.firstAction: Keep the provider setup unchanged and move to microphone, TTS, output device, language, and voice dependency checks.
statusRoutes.avoid: Do not rotate a working API key for a voice-only failure.

safeSupportSummaryFields: sanitized log line with no API key
